# QnALog 1.6.8

## Highlights

- The Notes tab no longer wraps every note in a redundant root folder. With a single notes folder, notes and sub-folders are listed directly; root-level notes appear under "Uncategorized" when sub-folders exist.
- The search and filter bar is now a search field plus one filter icon. Time range, template and grouping live in a compact popover that matches the existing segmented controls; active filters show as removable chips under the search field.
- Search now covers all notes in the list, not only the first 48 that were rendered. The list says when it is showing only the latest 48.
- Note rows are re-aligned: icon, title, metadata, actions and derived-version rows share the same alignment lines. The "Create topic" action appears on hover, like "Rename".
- Row metadata shows the duration with units (for example "15 min 53 s") so it no longer reads as a second clock time, and shows the date outside the "By time" grouping.
- The notes board can delete a group: an empty group, or a group that holds only notes (the notes move back to the root first). Folders go to Obsidian's trash setting; a group holding other files is refused.
- Fixed wrong interface text: the search placeholder showed "AI service temporarily unavailable", and the board's collapse button and menu showed "AI is filling in…".

## User impact

The settings schema and API key storage are unchanged. No notes are rewritten. Deleting a board group moves its folder to the trash according to your Obsidian "Deleted files" setting.
